name: cfg-config-warnings
about: 能启动但带警告的配置（只改诊断、不改行为的键）：未知顶层键 CONFIG_UNKNOWN_FIELD（loadPilotConfig.ts:343-376）；已移除的 agent.fallbackModel（:403-412）；已弃用的 agent.thinking 在 enabled 不是 true 时整段丢弃（:474-482）；agent.subagents.params / 未知子键（:494-520）；extension 未知键（:777-787）；memory 未知键、memory.schedule 未知键、memory.model 指向不存在的 provider（parseMemoryConfig.ts:46-66、:116-127、:150-170，enabled=false 不起记忆）；gateway.tokenPath 已移除（parseGatewayConfig.ts:34-42）、staticAssetsPath 解析但不用（静态目录仍是 <cwd>/ui/dist，这里放一个 index.html 看 GET / 是否被它影响）、port 不决定监听端口、idleSessionTimeoutMinutes / memoryDiagnostics 类型不对时静默回落缺省；cron 时区非法、并发数与超时非正整数、未知键（parseCronConfig.ts:40-80，回落缺省并警告）；runPolicy 与 failureGuard 的未知键（parseRunPolicyConfig.ts:20-30、80-90）。用 serve 起服务比启动输出，resolve_settings 比诊断与配置快照，再看 /health 与 GET /。
config:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  model: bbx/deterministic
  maxContextTokens: 65536
  maxOutputTokens: 8192
  fallbackModel: bbx/deterministic
  thinking:
    enabled: false
    budgetTokens: 5
  subagents:
    timeoutMs: 1000
    params:
      temperature: 1
    bogus: 2
model:
  providers:
    bbx:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        deterministic:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
telemetry:
  enabled: false
unknownTop: 1
extension:
  bogus: true
memory:
  enabled: false
  bogus: 1
  model: nope/none
  schedule:
    reasoningMode: answer_first
    bogus: 1
gateway:
  tokenPath: /tmp/nowhere/token
  staticAssetsPath: {ROOT}/static
  port: 1234
  idleSessionTimeoutMinutes: soon
  memoryDiagnostics: yes-please
cron:
  enabled: false
  timezone: Mars/Base
  maxConcurrentRuns: 0
  runTimeoutMinutes: 1.5
  bogus: 1
runPolicy:
  bogus: 1
  failureGuard:
    bogus: 1
